name: Toumei Co.,Ltd.
summary: Toumei Co.,Ltd. offers telecommunications services in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Office Hikari 119 Business, Office Solution Business, and Financial Planning Business. The Office Hikari 119 Business segment provides services related to the office communication environment, including optical fiber lines and internet service providers; and services related to communication infrastructure, such as the establishment of landline telephones and internet lines, installation of Wi-Fi hotspots, and review of DX services and communication environments.
